selection_basis: Official Table VI first physical-sensor normal scenario plus fixed HTTP/UDP attack categories; no model scores or selection by smallest size
download_order: Two fixed attacks first; if actual roles clearly do not match the fixed normal scenario or a legitimate physical target cannot be established, stop before normal and do not substitute another scenario. Otherwise acquire the single fixed normal and verify physical identity and chronology.
audit: single-member public file ZIP if applicable; exact listing bytes/CRC/local SHA; never substitute a whole dataset ZIP
stable physical target identity and device/server/VM roles across the three files
full unfiltered actual 7200s normal then later normal and causal attacks; no timestamp shifting, merging disjoint windows or using later normal
official attack direction/event semantics and actual directly attacking ACK=1 SYN=0 / UDP; reverse responses separate, no whole-file attack assumption
normal SYN/ACK/UDP distributions and same-protocol legal component population as header metadata only; no E3/q14 model input encoding
duplicate/interface-capture audit and individual target/capture/event counts, not frame count as independence
report failure or unresolved truth; no model score/support/distance or method change
stop_policy: Preserve and report qualification failure/unresolved identity or labels; no automatic new files/targets, no model execution, no deletions.
